title: Interleaver Benchmark Suite: parameter provenance, metric taxonomy and validated metrics (code)
description: MATLAB implementation of the interleaver evaluation suite of 'Code-Aware Interleaver Metrics for Burst-Error Channels: Taxonomy and Validation on a Provenance-Governed Benchmark': canonical interleaver implementations with declared parameter rules, the length-grid generator, precomputed permutation tables, the metric implementations, the simulation harness and the analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure. The campaign data are archived separately (see related identifiers).
